context:
Goal: the same team of sessions (coordinator, triage, batch runner, lanes) runs all on your Mac or all in the cloud, as one concept.
Problem (rule): you are right that the shape need not differ. The one real difference measured so far: in the cloud, a coordinator starts a lane session with no card; on the Mac, starting one session from another shows a card you must press, and the card drops the lane's branch. Our records answered that by making a Mac lane an agent instead of a session, which split the meaning of "lane".
Based on (ruling): lanes-start-as-agents (the Mac card cannot be turned off by any setting; the card drops the branch).
Based on (read): in the cloud this coordinator has started more than 30 lane sessions since Nov 1 with no card.
Departs from: lanes-start-as-agents and session-tiers, where a Mac lane is an agent — a lane is a session everywhere, local and cloud alike.

lastAnswer.note: Asked: "why do you think i cant have an all local run of coordinator triage batch merger and lane sessions and an all cloud variant of the same concept?". Rewritten 22:27 CST: one shape everywhere; the only measured difference is the Mac start card.

options.gain: One shape on the Mac and in the cloud; the branch is right even if the card stays.
options.how: A lane is always a session. A lane probe measures whether the Mac card still shows and still drops the branch on today's Claude version; until then, each Mac lane start is one press, and the lane brief sets its own branch first thing.
options.label: Sessions everywhere; probe the Mac card first
options.lose: One press per Mac lane until the card goes.

options.how: The session that reads the page answer starts each lane as a background agent in its own worktree, local and cloud alike.
options.label: Agents everywhere
options.lose: A lane ends with the session that started it; cloud lane sessions retire.

options.how: No change: Mac lanes are agents, cloud lanes are sessions.
options.label: Keep two meanings
options.lose: "Lane" keeps two meanings, which you asked to end.

ref: decisions session-tiers and lanes-start-as-agents; debt page-answer-second-click
title: One shape everywhere: coordinator, triage, batch runner and lane sessions, all local or all cloud. How does a local run start its lane sessions?
why: Recommended: a. It gives you the same shape on the Mac as in the cloud today; only the start press differs, and a probe may remove it. The probe must run in a session on your Mac: a cloud lane cannot see the Mac card (lane audit-owner-answers, 22:27 CST).
